annotations.text:
EXPEDITION INSTRUMENT

Space Grotesk + IBM Plex Mono with tabular numerals. Hairline rules instead of panel borders, no glass-on-glass. Cyan = interactive / portals. Warm gold = your trail (history), used nowhere else.
HELM — the only persistent control that changes the world. Beside the stage, not among the utility icons, and inside the thumb zone on touch.
TRAIL rail, collapsed. Space is reserved now; the panel gets built after traversal becomes a visit graph. The scrim chevron (TRAIL · 4) is its collapsed handle.
LEDGER — shown at OPEN (~40vh). The three-bar meter beside the chevron is the state indicator: peek / open / full.
Ledger at PEEK — title plus four readouts, ~144px. Helm floats clear of it. No fake status bar or home indicator drawn: safe-area insets leave that space to the OS.

The `short` breakpoint (max-height: 520px) flips the Ledger to a right drawer and the Helm to the left edge. A bottom sheet here would leave the world a letterbox slit — this is the case the current UI has no answer for at all.

STILL UNDRAWN

· Launch screen (no realm yet)
· Portal preview + travel dive
· Ledger at FULL
· Diegetic legend

Say the word and these get their own page.
